hook: Leave your sleepers untouched to gather Age, then pass it along the row to tip them awake.
loop: Leave Still units untouched; move Age with bats and dormice.
Age piles up as pips, nearing Awaken thresholds.
Thresholds land: stats, gold, damage, and the Eldest's board-doubling Awaken.

growth.line: Age climbs a pip a turn; weak until about turn 8, then stats bend sharply upward.

feel.early: Pale, thin board; loses fights in rounds 3-6.
feel.mid: Thresholds land; route Age to tip Awakens.
feel.late: Eldest and Hrošč turn every pip into huge stats.

stars.why: Placement becomes Age routing; a fresh Eldest beside him is strongest.
The chase: grows the board from Age, Awaken 20 doubles it.
The seed in one line: every Age gained becomes stats.

card_short.u02: When played: gives 1 Age to each neighbour.
card_short.u03: Selling a unit sends its Age to your youngest unit.
card_short.u04: Still. End of Turn: oldest unit gains stats from its Age.
card_short.u05: Still. Start of Turn: cashes up to 2 Age into gold.
card_short.u06: Still. Gives Still to its neighbours, any tribe.
card_short.u07: Still. Awaken 4: grows big, gives neighbours 2 Age.
card_short.u08: Still. Awaken 3: permanently buffs its neighbours.
card_short.u09: Still. Start of Combat: hits lowest-Health enemy for 2x Age.
card_short.u10: Neighbours gain 1 extra Age from Still.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: feeds your youngest stats from oldest's Age.
card_short.u12: Play beside him: pulls Age from his other side onto it.
card_short.u14: Still. Others' Awaken repeats at 2N, 3N and so on.
card_short.u15: End of Turn: units played or moved gain 1 Age.
card_short.u16: Start of Combat: hits each enemy for 2x Age across it.
card_short.u17: Still. Board grows from Age; Awaken 20 doubles the board.
card_short.u18: Doubles stats and damage counted from Age; not Awaken.
card_short.u19: Still. Start of Combat: +1/+1 per Age on your board.

builds.name: The Long Sleep
builds.line: Never move anything; Hatchlings and Bellman, finish on Eldest and Hrošč.

builds.name: The Relay
builds.line: Pass Age with Netopir and Echo Bat to reach Awaken 20.

builds.name: The Hidden Passage
builds.line: Start of Combat damage from Age; Parkelj lets you line up.

liked: All three named Brother Netopir's Age relay a standout: placement becomes routing.
Movable, spendable Age with oldest/youngest targeting gives real choices each turn.
worries: Watch with Hrošč: Robber-Knight, Dragon and Painter numbers; Eldest's Awaken doubles the board.
Old Polh with Ribica prints Hams forever; Long Sleep has few decisions late.
changed: Mother Ribica's repeat Awakens now step at 2N, 3N, once a turn.
Hrošč says plainly what it doubles; copies and Awakens don't stack.
Golden Echo Bat and Netopir capped so Age can't grow without limit.
verdict: Players who love routing Age get a slow, patient game where sleepers wake at big thresholds.
